format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <script>customElements.whenDefined('sf-list').then(() => {const list = document.querySelector('#l'); list.actions = [{id: 'delete', text: 'Удалить', icon: 'delete', destructive: true}]; const now = Date.now(); list.items = [{id: 't1', text: 'Возврат товара', date: new Date(now).toISOString()}, {id: 't2', text: 'План на квартал', date: new Date(now).toISOString()}, {id: 't3', text: 'Тарифы', date: new Date(now - 2 * 86400000).toISOString()}]; list.addEventListener('sf-list-load-more', (event) => event.preventDefault());});</script>

probes.title: the list is one Tab stop; ArrowDown goes from the last row of a group to the first of the next; Enter asks open {id, trigger: keyboard}
probes.covers: keyboard.host Tab, keyboard.row ArrowDown/End, events.open, group-by day

probes.title: F2 opens the rename field with the focus in it; Enter keeps: rename {id, text} once, the new text shown, the focus back on its row
Shift+F10 opens the row's menu (Переименовать, Удалить); choosing Удалить is apply {action: delete, scope: entry, ids: [t3]}

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__menu').dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sf-menu-context-select', {bubbles: true, detail: {id: 'action:delete'}})), document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__menu').close({restoreFocus: true}), true)

probes.title: request-more asks load-more {direction: after, after: t3}; the page's cancel makes it refused prevented; detach of the focused row gives the focus to its neighbour

1.1.0: a pinned item leads under «Закреплённые» before the day groups; an avatar gives every row the leading place; a count and a badge stand at the row's end; a count that changes keeps the row and the focus on it

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#l').items = [{id: 'p1', text: 'Канал', avatar: {icon: 'campaign', shape: 'square'}, pinned: true}, {id: 't1', text: 'Возврат товара', avatar: {text: 'АБ'}, count: 3, date: new Date().toISOString()}, {id: 't2', text: 'План на квартал', badge: {text: 'Ждёт', tone: 'warning'}, date: new Date().toISOString()}], true)
steps.check: document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__group')?.dataset.group === 'pinned' && document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__group .sf-list__heading')?.textContent.trim() === 'Закреплённые' && document.querySelectorAll('#l .sf-list__lead').length === 3 && document.querySelectorAll('#l sf-avatar').length === 1 && document.querySelectorAll('#l .sf-list__sign').length === 1 && document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__row[data-id="t1"] .sf-list__count')?.textContent.includes('3') && document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__row[data-id="t2"] .sf-list__badge')?.getAttribute('status') === 'warning'

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__row[data-id="t1"] .sf-list-item').focus(), window.__row = document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__row[data-id="t1"] .sf-list-item'), document.querySelector('#l').upsert({id: 't1', text: 'Возврат товара', avatar: {text: 'АБ'}, count: 0, date: new Date().toISOString()}).outcome)

probes.title: no-wrap: a long title and its second line stay one line each, cut with an ellipsis; the whole text stays in the row and is its tooltip; the «⋯» is shown without a hover

steps.script: (() => {const list = document.querySelector('#l'); list.items = [{id: 'w1', text: 'Очень длинное название беседы, которому не хватит места в одной строке списка', supporting: 'И вторая строка, которая тоже длиннее, чем ширина колонки беседы', date: new Date().toISOString()}, {id: 'w2', text: 'Короткая', date: new Date().toISOString()}]; list.noWrap = true; return true;})()
steps.check: (() => {const row = document.querySelector('#l .sf-list__row[data-id="w1"]'); const title = row?.querySelector('.sf-list-item-title'); const host = row?.querySelector('sf-list-item'); const more = row?.querySelector('.sf-list__actions'); const style = title && getComputedStyle(title); return Boolean(document.querySelector('#l .sf-list--no-wrap')) && style?.whiteSpace === 'nowrap' && style?.textOverflow === 'ellipsis' && title.scrollWidth > title.clientWidth && title.textContent.includes('одной строке списка') && host?.getAttribute('title') === 'Очень длинное название беседы, которому не хватит места в одной строке списка · И вторая строка, которая тоже длиннее, чем ширина колонки беседы' && more && getComputedStyle(more).opacity === '1' && getComputedStyle(more).visibility === 'visible' && more.getBoundingClientRect().right <= row.getBoundingClientRect().right + 0.5;})()
